item.meaning: The process of increasing the monetary and functional worth of raw materials through human skill, labor, and technology.

item.definition: Any human effort performed to produce, process, or deliver goods and services in exchange for money or money's worth.
An activity performed out of affection, gratitude, care, or social duty without generating monetary compensation.
Selfless service carried out for the welfare of others and the community without expecting personal or financial reward.

item.title: Transformation of Resources via Skill
item.explanation: Economic value addition occurs when human skill, labor, and machinery transform raw materials (e.g. ₹600 wood) into functional products (e.g. ₹1,000 chair).

item.name: Swami Vivekananda
item.role_or_contribution: Prominent Indian philosopher who taught that work performed with full devotion and selfless spirit is the highest form of worship.

item.description: The varied ways work is financially rewarded: Salary (fixed monthly), Wage (daily/task), Fee (professional service), or Payment in Kind (goods/crops).

item.concept: Unpaid Domestic Labor and Social Care
item.description: Essential household, cooking, and eldercare work performed without financial payment that sustains family and societal well-being.
